what: 30 blurry bokeh orbs (50px, blur 40px, opacity .5, size .3~1×) are scattered at random spots on the plate, and each orb gets scroll parallax of size² × 500% (+d% → −d% while passing from the bottom of the screen to the top), so big orbs pass faster. In place, they float up and down ±50~100% of their own height over 2~3s with easeInOut, returning and repeating. It gives the depth of dust light floating on a dark background

options.depth: Parallax strength — % multiplied by size², default 500
options.--fx-size · --fx-blur · --fx-alpha · --f: Blob diameter, blur, opacity and color (via style), default 50px · 40px · .5 · --kf-ink

from.where: shared .ok-bokeh (behind every page — original: react-scroll-parallax y [500·s², −500·s²] · framer-motion y [−r%, r%] easeInOut repeat ∞ reverse 2~3s · r = ±50~100 · s = .3~1, blob 50px #fff blur(40px) opacity .5)

note: Position and size are random each time it opens (same as the original). If the panel is long the blobs get sparse, so raise count to fit the panel height
